messages:
Alice C: Taking over primary for 20:00-04:00 UTC. Quick heads-up — there is an active partial-failure on kafka-proxy affecting model-ingest path (elevated 5xx rate). PD incident #2345 is open. I started the usual mitigations: scaled proxy replicas, bumped rate-limiter, and flipped on circuit-breaker retries.

incident-bot: INCIDENT #2345 | kafka-proxy: increased 5xx rate on /v1/ingest | severity=high | triggered=1761232000 | status=open

Alice C: Timeline so far — 19:42 spike observed, 19:50 autoscaler fired, 19:58 retries kicked, 20:01 partial drop in errors but still above target. Consumer lag on ingest-consumers increased ~2-3x.

Jorge R: I can shadow first 30m and keep an eye on consumer lag and pod restarts. Paging window ok?

Alice C: yes please shadow. Primary action items: 1) watch 5xx ratio, 2) check consumer lag, 3) validate any downstream backpressure. If 5xx ratio > 2% sustained for 5m, escalate.

Laila S: Quick note — runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/kafka-proxy-retry (use the `retry-policy` section). If we get sustained errors after retries, follow "Escalate to runtime lead" with PD.

pagerduty-bot: Paging oncall_ENG -> @Alice C :rotating_light: (notify level: primary)

Alice C: confirming pager hit. If we need to escalate past oncall, page Raj (runtime lead) and Emma (support) depending on customer impact.

Emma H: I'll stand by for customer comms. If there is any confirmed data loss or long-term lag, I can open a status page draft.

Laila S: Escalation checklist (short):
```
- Alert threshold: 5xx ratio > 2% for 5m OR consumer lag > 10k for 10m
- First escalation: page oncall-sre -> @Raj Patel (pager), include incident id and short logs
- Secondary escalation: eng-runtime owners (Emma H) + product oncall if customer-facing features are impacted
```

Raj Patel: If I'm paged, first action I'll take is validate the circuit-breaker config and check kernel OOM/process restarts. Also check for recent deploys on runtime (last 2 hours).

Alice C: quick commands for anyone who jumps in:
```bash
# pod errors last 10m
kubectl logs -l app=kafka-proxy -n prod --since=10m | grep -E "5.." | tail -n 200
# consumer lag (kafkacat/monitor)
kafka-lag-check --group ingest-group --topic model-ingest
```

Jorge R: saw a flurry of retries around 19:56, pushing messages back into the queue. Lag spike appears to be transient but monitoring. I'm watching consumer lag dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/kafka/ingest?orgId=1

infra-bot: Runbook check: kafka-proxy-retry v2.1 found. No open maintenance windows.

Alice C: Decision points for escalation: if error ratio stays >2% for 5m -> page Raj. If customer impact detected (requests failing for >5% of requests for >10m) -> page Emma + product oncall and start customer comms.

Jorge R: ack. I'll hold a 10-min cadence updates in this thread — will post if anything changes.

20:10 Alice C: small improvement observed; 5xx ratio down to 1.4% over 5m but we still see occasional spikes tied to one region (us-west-2).

20:18 Laila S: FYI, if region-specific, consider routing fallback to us-east-1 model cluster per routing play: https://opsplaybooks/internal/routing-fallback. Use canary 10% traffic shift first.

20:22 incident-bot: INCIDENT #2345 updated | severity=mitigated | notes="error rate reduced, monitoring" | updated_by=Alice C

20:28 Alice C: putting a note — I'm handing off primary in 30m. Jorge to remain secondary for next 2 hours. Runbook owners: Laila to own initial triage PM, Raj if escalation needed.

20:30 Jorge R: continuing shadow. All dashboards green vs threshold. Will escalate if anything crosses the listed thresholds.

20:33 pagerduty-bot: Clear for PD alert -> incident #2345 (no further pages)

20:38 Alice C: Handoff complete. Checklist done: briefed secondary, shared runbook link, confirmed retries/circuit-breaker state, left remediation TODOs. Please capture any follow-ups in the incident doc: https://incidents.internal/2345

Emma H: Noted — I'll prepare a short post-incident notification template in case we need to communicate.

Raj Patel: Thanks team. If anything flares up, re-page me. Otherwise I'll review the traces tomorrow.

Laila S: Postmortem owner assigned: Laila S. Will start an initial timeline and collect logs.

Alice C: thanks all :thumbsup:
